content: De Teacha Dem wa Ain Taak True

Bot some dem prophet wa been dey mix op wid de people, dey ain been no prophet fa true. Cause dey say dey da taak God wod, bot dey ain da taak God wod none tall. Same way so, dey gwine be people mix op wid oona. Some ob dem wa da laan oona bout God ain gwine taak true. Fo oona ketch op ta wa dey da do, dey gwine laan people ting wa ain true, wa kin stroy um. Dem teacha eben gwine ton dey back pon de Lawd wa done pay fa dey life wen e dead pon de cross. An dat gwine mek um git stroy all ob a sudden.
Heapa people gwine folla dem fa lib loose life. An wa dey da do gwine mek people taak bad ginst de true way we folla.

Cause dey got de big eye, dem teacha gwine tell oona ting wa ain true, so dat dey kin git oona money. Way back dey, God done condemn um an cide fa stroy um. God ain neba sleep, an e gwine stroy um fa sho!
God ain spare de angel dem wen dey been sin, ainty? E chunk um way eenta hell, wa daak mo den de night. God mek um stay dey, fa wait til de Jedgiment Day.

God ain spare de people wa lib way back dey, ainty? E sen de flood fa kiba op de wol an all de people wa ain wahn fa do wa God tell um. Bot God ain leh no wata kiba Noah, wa beena tell people fa do wa right een God eye. God sabe Noah fom de wata, long wid seben oda people.

An God condemn de people wa lib een Sodom an Gomorrah, ainty? E done stroy um, bun um all op wid fire. E done dat fa mek people wa come later on, see wa gwine happen ta dem wa ain wahn fa do wa God tell um fa do.
Den too, God sabe Lot, wa beena waak scraight wid um, ainty? An Lot been opsot fa true cause ob de loose life de wickity people beena lib all roun bout um.
Dat man Lot wa waak right, e beena lib mongst dem people. E been bex een e good haat ebry day an e suffa fa true, cause ob all de wickity ting e beena see an yeh dem people do.
All dis show dat fa true, de Lawd know how fa bring people wa lib fa God outta dey fliction, wiles e da lick dem wa ain fa do wa God tell um, da keep um til de Jedgiment Day come.

Mo den all, God gwine lick dem wa lib loose life, da folla dey haat fa do dorty ting wid dey body, an God gwine lick dem wa hate tority too. Dem teacha wa laan people ting wa ain true, dey ain got no shame, an dey da do wasoneba dey head gim fa do. Dey ain scaid fa sult dem wa got powa fa rule oba people.
Angel dem got scrent an powa mo den dem wickity teacha. Stillyet, eben de angel dem ain neba sult dem teacha wen dey cuse um fo de Lawd.

Bot dem teacha yah, dey taak bad bout ting dey ain know nottin bout. Dey jes like wile animal wa ain tink tall. Dey jes do wa dey head gim fa do. So jes like de wile animal dem git bon an come eenta de wol fa leh people ketch um op an kill um, same way so, God gwine stroy dem wickity people.

Cause dey beena mek people suffa, dey gwine suffa too an git dey payback. Eben een de day time, dey heppy fa do wasoneba dey feel like wid dey body. Dey da shame an disgrace oona wen oona all nyam togeda, same time dey heppy cause ob de way dey da ceebe oona.

Dey eye ain scraight. Dey wahn fa lib loose life an sleep roun wid ebry ooman dey see. Dey all de time wahn fa sin mo an mo. Dey da draw people wa ain got dey own mind, fa folla um fa do bad. Dey big eye da trol um so dat dey wahn fa git all ting fa deysef. God done condemn um an dey gwine be stroy.

Dem wickity people yah done lef de way wa right, an dey done loss. Dey beena waak een de way wa Balaam, Beor son, beena waak. Balaam been hab de big eye. E lob de money e fa git fa do ting wa ain right.
Bot Balaam own donkey taak like a man ta um an e buke um fa de bad ting e beena do like a crazy man. Cause ob dat, Balaam ain do dat bad ting e been wahn fa do.

Dem wickity people same like well wa ain got no wata een um. Dey like daak cloud wa da show dat rain wahn fa come. Bot de big breeze blow um way, an ain no rain come tall. God da keep a daak daak place fa pit dem people.

Dey da taak loud bout wa ain mean nottin. Dey lib loose life. An dey tek op de dorty ting dey wahn een dey haat an draw people wa jes staat fa scape fom oda people wa lib een de way wa ain right. Dem wickity people been lead um fa lib bad life gin.

Dey da tell people say dey gwine be free, bot deysef ain free tall. Dey slabe, cause dey ebil way da trol um. Cause wen somebody ain able fa stop do sompin, dat one done come fa be slabe ta dat ting dey.

People come fa know bout we Lawd an Sabior Jedus Christ, an cause ob dat, dey scape fom dey ebil way wa da stroy people een de wol. Bot den ef dey ton back an go ta dat kind ob bad life gin an dey ain able fa lef dey ebil way gin, den dey life gwine be bad way mo den e been.
E been way mo betta ef dey ain neba know de right way wa God wahn um fa bleebe an fa waak, den fa dem fa know de right way an den ton back an stop folla God chaage wa e gim.
Wa happen ta dem wa ton way fom God, dat jes like dem true paable wa tell we say, “Dog da ton back fa go lick e womit,” an “Hog wa dey done wash, e go back fa roll een de mud.”
